result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is 1Password if you prioritize ease of use and smooth team collaboration. Choose Bitwarden if you want excellent security and team-management features at a lower price.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

# \$8.99

Per user/month, annual billing

- Very easy for employees to use.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Excellent onboarding and offboarding.
- Strong admin controls and security reporting.

Best for teams that want a polished, low-maintenance solution.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![‎Bitwarden App - App Store](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/x38pyi5v1Vy6Zs97qz8ZgS0U3TY6bP46EZUol0vjWY-QJEsjpBL1sBYpo0AxExRZj59SXzc9D5J1hCMKpLCQRKtRmi0IYkc0CeiDQsrny4xPWuRz2OGsqZ9tyuMm4GtN5vMAwBBf6hXgHDHMP9_wXSBVttW9bXO5pQrWG4hhS-RxRNQIRTsbPrqb3y45Jv-M?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

# \$4

Per user/month, annual billing

- Open-source foundation.
- Shared collections and organization management.
- Audit logs and directory integration.
- Excellent value for growing teams.

Best for cost-conscious businesses and technically minded teams.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

# \$2–4

Starting per user/month, depending on plan

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Delegated administration.
- Good fit for organizations with compliance requirements.

Best for businesses needing more structured access management.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Dashlane Password Manager - Productivity App | MWM](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/sjKEnc0-fPSrNqcxg632k2LsBv013jUcwYRRRFBtcM4jJvhfaV4R-pujj7qAehiPzT1cTFXTzWEXX9oHlGzAptfQkRhbi8qP8iQ0988C9QxscIXoPYcuBcOyQb2Af9AH8UZ94UR2tMHYRyo1y8r8JALEVHUzBLdiVqEL6adsEykVdzYzUhWmkr_9_-vfGxYV?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

- User-friendly interface.
- Credential risk monitoring.
- Security alerts and administrative tools.

Best if you want additional employee credential-risk monitoring.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

*Pricing is based on published November 2026 comparisons; confirm current plan details before purchasing.* [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for in a team password manager

Regardless of which product you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Employees can access shared credentials without sending passwords through email or Slack.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Everyone has their own login.
3. **Access controls\:** Restrict who can view, edit, and share credentials.
4. **Easy offboarding\:** Revoke someone's access immediately when they leave.
5. **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication.
6. **Audit logs\:** See who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## My recommendation

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall experience | 1Password |
| Best value | Bitwarden |
| Strong administration | Keeper |
| Credential-risk monitoring | Dashlane |


I'd personally narrow it down to 1Password and Bitwarden.

## A couple of questions

I can make a much more specific recommendation with two details\:

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

- 2–5
- 6–10
- 11–25
- 26–50
- 50+

**2\. What type of business is it?**

- Small business / general office
- Software development / IT
- Professional services / consulting
- Healthcare
- Other

That will help me recommend the right plan without paying for enterprise features you probably don't need.
